verdicts.reason: A stacks logo, can, headline, body and CTA in a tight, evenly spaced column. Hierarchy and reading order are clear, and the decorative circles are shrunk to corner accents. Its flaws are minor: the CTA is very heavy for the format and the area below it is somewhat empty. B puts the SOLSTICE wordmark on top of the green circle and leaves big uneven gaps around the headline and body. The CTA is pushed down against the bottom edge with small button text, and it sits on top of the yellow circle, so spacing and grouping look accidental.
